Hot and Arid.ventilation_strategy: Night purge cooling with compact daytime thermal mass buffering
Hot and Arid.design_priority: High Thermal Mass + Solar Shading + Minimum Glazing

Warm and Humid.ventilation_strategy: Continuous cross-ventilation with elevated floor and high ceiling vents
Warm and Humid.design_priority: Maximum Airflow + Large Shading Eaves + Lightweight Envelope

Cold and High-Altitude.ventilation_strategy: Controlled airtight ventilation with South-facing direct solar heat gain
Cold and High-Altitude.design_priority: Continuous Envelope Insulation + Solar Heat Trap + Compact Geometry

Composite / Moderate.ventilation_strategy: Seasonal operable windows with moderate thermal mass

passive_strategies.name: Solar Orientation Optimization
passive_strategies.rule: Align major longitudinal facade within ±15° of North-South axis to minimize direct East-West solar heating.

passive_strategies.name: Overhang Solar Cutoff
passive_strategies.rule: Eave overhang depth should equal at least 25% of window vertical height.

passive_strategies.name: Natural Cross-Ventilation
passive_strategies.rule: Provide inlet and outlet openings on opposite or adjacent walls with total area >= 15% of floor area.
